description: According to the text of the United States Constitution, the President of the United States, acting on his own, does not have the power to impose tariffs. Article I, Section 8 of the Constitution, states that Congress—not the President—has the “power to lay and collect Taxes, Duties, Imposts, and Excises. . .”.
